name: Refugee Academic Futures Scholarship
funding: Covers course fees and provides a grant for living costs for the full duration of fee liability.
academicRequirements: Applicants applying to any full-time and part-time DPhil and master's courses at Oxford.
otherRequirements: Applicants must have lived experience of displacement and select the 'refugee status' box on the application form. Eligible applicants will be invited to submit an additional scholarship application in March/April 2026.
description: The Refugee Academic Futures Scholarship supports graduate students at Oxford with lived experience of displacement. It covers course fees and living costs for the entire duration of the program. Applicants must apply by the December or January deadline and indicate their refugee status to be considered for an invitation to apply for the scholarship.

name: Crankstart Graduate Scholarship
funding: 100% of course fees and a grant for living costs. Scholarships are awarded for the duration of your fee liability.
academicRequirements: Any applicant to a postgraduate course who has at any time been in receipt of funding in the form of a Crankstart undergraduate scholarship.
otherRequirements: Available for UK residents from lower-income households who were former undergraduate Crankstart scholars.
description: The Crankstart Graduate Scholarship supports former Crankstart undergraduate scholars from lower-income households in the UK pursuing postgraduate study at Oxford. It covers 100% of course fees and provides a living costs grant for the full duration of the degree. Applicants are considered based on academic merit and potential, with most offers sent by mid-June.

name: Felix Scholarships
funding: 100% of course fees, a grant for living costs (around £19,000) and one return flight from India/home country to the UK.
academicRequirements: Outstanding students from India, or a non-Indian student ordinarily resident in a low income country outside India, to pursue graduate studies in any subject.
otherRequirements: Administered by partner universities (Oxford, Reading, SOAS).
description: The Felix Scholarship supports outstanding graduate students, primarily from India, to study at the University of Oxford, University of Reading, or SOAS. The scholarship covers full course fees, living costs of approximately £19,000, and a return flight. A limited number of awards are also available to non-Indian students from low-income countries.
